description: Java source code for an Android activity class 'MyRssReader4' that displays and manages an RSS feed list, including menu options for starting/stopping services, adding, deleting, and updating RSS items, with a custom cursor adapter for list display.

classes.name: MyRssReader4
classes.description: Main activity class for RSS reader, managing list display, menu actions, and interactions.

classes.name: RssCursorAdapter
classes.description: Custom adapter extending SimpleCursorAdapter to display RSS items with different styles based on read status.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, populates list with RSS items.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Creates menu options for start/stop service, add, delete, update.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares menu before display (currently no dynamic changes).

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item clicks for starting/stopping service, adding, deleting, updating RSS items.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles result from add RSS item activity, inserting new item into content provider.
